item.title: Ligonier Valley knocks off Keystone Oaks in 1st round, earns ‘program-defining’ win
item.description: Last year, Ligonier Valley made the 54-mile trip to Keystone Oaks for a Class 3A boys basketball first-round playoff game. The Rams were bounced from the postseason in a 15-point loss to the Golden Eagles.
